results.summary: The control flow and arithmetic largely match, but the offset and call signatures are not verified faithfully.
issues: The word at offset +0x04 is accessed as current[1] instead of a named struct member.
Both callees are declared __fastcall, while the supplied P-code shows their arguments in stack locations. The declared calling conventions are unsupported and may pass the wrong arguments.
